prompt: White fixes the streetlamp before dark
title: Streetlamp Glow
irony: White hurries to fix the streetlamp all by herself before dark, yet the lamp only lights when she stops rushing and lets Green help her finish it.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunset paints the street gold as Green and Navy race scooters past the dark streetlamp.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green begs for one more street game before dark while White checks her toolbox and Jade dares to climb.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The streetlamp sputters out and Black bets the dark beats White's fix.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All the kids chant for the streetlamp glow as White rolls up her sleeves.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: White's first bulb fizzles out as Green quotes the manual from the ground and Jade grabs the ladder.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black dares Jade to shake the pole and the ladder wobbles under a cloud of moths.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant for the streetlamp glow again as dusk deepens around them.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White gazes at the dark lamp and admits fixing alone keeps her from her kids.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White asks Green to hold the lamp steady and Green hands her the right bulb.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: White twists the last wire with Green and the lamp blooms on over their cheers.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Under the warm streetlamp glow the whole street plays on past dusk.
